parameters.name: Timeout
parameters.description: The timeout period of the asynchronous rollback operation. Unit: seconds. Default value: 300.

parameters.name: ToAppVersion
parameters.description: The target version number. By default, the system automatically rolls back the container version to the previous version.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ens rollback-application --app-id 474bdef0-d149-4695-abfb-52912d910000 --from-app-version v2-1 --to-app-version v2 --timeout 1800 --region cn-hangzhou
